messages.content: You check whether the evidence collected so far is enough to answer a question about a scientific paper. Say sufficient only if, for EVERY sub-question, some evidence item contains the specific fact, number or picture that answers it -- not merely the same topic. If sufficient, give for each sub-question the id of that item (E1, E2, ...) and copy the answering fact in a few words. Otherwise list the numbers of the sub-questions still uncovered and say in a few words what is missing.

Question: Which model performs the best in terms of AUC on the MovieLens-1M dataset?
Sub-questions:
1. [table] Which model performs the best in terms of AUC on the MovieLens-1M dataset?
Evidence:
E1 [table, Table 4, page 9]: Table 4: The results of AUC w.r.t. different sizes of a user’s ripple set.
Size of ripple set | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 | 32 | 64
MovieLens-1M | 0.903 | 0.908 | 0.911 | 0.918 | 0.920 | 0.919
Book-Crossing | 0.694 | 0.696 | 0.708 | 0.726 | 0.706 | 0.711
Bing-News | 0.659 | 0.672 | 0.670 | 0.673 | 0.678 | 0.671

answers.fact: MovieLens-1M has an AUC of 0.920 with a ripple set size of 32.
